name: roofs_mixed_d
prompt:
Image 1 is the finished sheet; image 2 is its layout: 8 building outlines seen from above on flat magenta, in a 3×3 grid. Redraw only cells 2, 3 and 4 (the transparent areas). Keep every other cell exactly as it is, and match their style, colours and fine detail.

The fault in those three cells: each showed a wall seen from the side along its bottom edge — cell 2 a row of roller garage doors about 1.6 m deep, cells 3 and 4 a strip of shop windows under the sign. From straight above no wall, door or window can be seen. The roof fills the whole outline edge to edge; along the thick bottom edge there is only the roof's own parapet (cell 2) or a flat sign strip about 0.6 m deep lying on the roof (cells 3 and 4), and nothing below it. Air conditioner units at their true size, about 1 m, smaller than those drawn in cell 1.

For each redrawn cell, trace the outline in image 2 exactly, keep its proportions, straight square edges, top-down with no perspective, and keep the magenta background flat pure #FF00FF outside it. No text.

2. 15 × 11.1 m (1.4× wider than deep) — row of 4 lock-up garages of a garage cooperative, flat roof of rusty corrugated metal parted by low brick parapets between the units, patched in places
3. 7.8 × 11.1 m (1.4× deeper than wide) — single-storey shop pavilion, flat grey roof with an air conditioner unit and a sign along the front edge, standing narrow end to the street with the entrance on that short front wall
4. 15.6 × 11.1 m (1.4× wider than deep) — single-storey shop pavilion, flat grey roof with an air conditioner unit and a sign along the front edge
